caption: Kar. 41. Stela (ll. 13–15 added). (Kar. Cem., Pl. 19, No. 7104)
labels: a, by line 1 (small italic 'a' at the right end of line 1, probably a reference mark)
reading: wosi : asor[.](2)yi : brḫlt(3)lowi : wosni(4)sekrorolowi : (5)s[.]sime?te : sloy(6)se mñp?[.]tetowi : (7)mr?ẖ?lt?i : aro(8)selowi : m?kesḫl? (9)[.]npte?ote?[.] : yet(10)mdelowi : slosr(11)se : n?ptokelo(12)[.]wi : (13)w[.]d?mr?to?my lklkelte?(14)[.]m?sbd?bto : ysesoe(15)[.]retestto :
notes: Lines 13-15 were added later (caption). 3-shaped signs (m/ẖ/s) mostly taken as s unless the shape is the tall hooked ℷ (m); several of these could be m or ẖ. l. 3: 'sloy(6)se' - after y stands a long stroke descending below the line, under the number 6; taken as a 4th stroke of y, could be o. l. 3: ᒪ with dot read to (ب). l. 7: 'ẖ?lt?i' - the last two signs are ϟ joined by a bar to a 4: l+i, or te. l. 8: o+s (3/) not q. l. 9: '/ϟ—' groups read te; the second has a hatched tick and might be t. l. 11: 'slosr', 3-shapes uncertain. l. 13: a sign like an open ∪ read to?, could be ḫ. l. 14: 'lklkel' - small flat-topped ϟ read l, S read e; Ʒ with long tail read k. l. 14: ϰ-like sign read d, could be ñ. l. 15: '/ϟ—' with stem read te; could be t + o. Hatched patches with nothing readable written [.] (one per sign width).

caption: Kar. 42. Altar
reading: wosi : (2)soreyi : (3)m?etekdilowi : [.][.][.][.][.]yi : (4)k?ñr? : tedḫelowi : slḫ(5)teyo? : terikelowi : de?(6)rekesi(7)lowi : br(8)l?rlowi : (9)sebo?ñye : (10)tedḫelowi : n(11)s?otr : terikelebkwi : (12)alsse psosebḫe(13)kete : a(14)tm?ẖ?e : psi(15)ḫrbḫe(16)kete : ḫslo(17)l : s?olbḫeke(18)te :
notes: l. 3/4: five dots trailing diagonally after 'yi' at the right end of the second row, read as five lost signs (count approximate). l. 4: first sign k? is hatched at the top; ω after ñ hatched (r?). l. 5: 'teyo?' - after te three strokes in two groups ('/ ll'), read y + o; could be y alone. l. 6: the line number 6 is printed as a small circle over ω. l. 8: ϟ under the number 8 is large (l? or e). l. 9: an open box with a tall right arm read b? (could be to). l. 11: flat-topped 3 with a lower-left tail taken as s, separate from the slash (o), so not q. l. 11-12: 'terikelebkwi' - three S-like signs after k, read e, l (9-shaped), e. l. 12, 15: the a-sign written S + 2 with long tail. l. 14: 'at mẖe' - the two 3-shapes read m and ẖ (formula ato/at mḫe); could be m+s. l. 18: '/3' read s+o; could be q.

caption: Kar. 43. Stela with male figure
reading: wo?si : soreyi (2)tedeylowi n?l b : slḫse (3)tewi : a?rikela?ḫ?(4)osbo : sḫe o? : yib[.][.][.][.]k (5)te : a(6)ḫm (7)yiboke(8)too?
notes: Copy drawn in a thinner, sketchier hand (lines 4-8 very faint). l. 1: the o of wosi is a small crossed/hatched mark (o?). l. 2: 'tedeylowi' - after te: ϰ with tick (d), S (e), three small strokes with a slash (y). l. 2: sign after lowi hatched, ϰ with long tail (n? or d). l. 3-4: 'a?rikela?ḫ?' - far right an S then a 2 with long tail (a?), then ω with a 4-like hook (r i), k, e, then a small s before a 2 with long tail (a?), then a small ᑕ-like sign (ḫ?). l. 4: number 4 printed as a dot over '3/'; 3 has a dot below. l. 5: four short ticks before k read as four lost signs. l. 7: number 7 is a small tick over the strokes of y. Last sign of l. 8 a lone slash (o?), no final divider.

caption: Kar. 44. Stela
reading: wosi : sore(2)yi : si ntme(3)qowi : mkesḫe : (4)kntowi : q?ni : (5)sstowi : tmes(6)ḫide : teri(7)kelowi : o?yi(8)tel?i : d?ḫelo(9)wi
notes: l. 1: y written as strokes crossing the i (4//). l. 3: '13' after the 3 (number 3) read q; 'qowi'. l. 4 and l. 5: ɷ-shaped loop read to (Kar. table form of tê/to). 'q?ni' - slash and 3 read q, could be s+o. l. 5: 3-shapes after (5) read s s; could be m/ẖ. l. 6: '4c' read ḫ + i. l. 8: first group '4 4/' unclear, read o? y i; 'S4' after te read l i (or e i). l. 9: first sign a bold ع-like form read d?; no final divider.

caption: Kar. 45. Altar

reading: wosi (2)sore?yi : (3)soerem tel?ol?iamy?(4)wi : q?ni : knitowi : b kirebe(5)my?wi [.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.](9)ter?ike(10)lebkwi : ato?mẖe pso(11)bḫte a?tmẖe psḫrbḫ(12)te ḫm
notes: l. 2: e of soreyi crossed by a thin diagonal line (altered or damaged?). l. 3: small S after o read e ('soerem'). l. 3: '4ϟ' joined group read l? i (could be te); 'ℷ //' - two strokes after m read y?. l. 5: 'ℷ //' again read m y. l. 6-8 and start of l. 9: 'about 30 lost' in the copy, written as 30 [.] (count is Griffith's estimate). l. 9: r and the slash of te drawn in thin line (faint); a crack crosses the i. l. 10: 'lebkwi'. l. 11: 'ato mẖe': to is ب with hatching under it; 3-shape read ẖ by the formula, could be m/s. l. 12: a-sign's S hatched. l. 13 (last row): 'ḫm' beside a thin wavy line (edge or crack), also a thin wavy stroke at the end of l. 5.

caption: Kar. 46. Altar
labels: sic, by line 4 (over the hatched sign just before the divider and line 5)
notes: l. 3: '4///' at the number 3 read y i; ϟ joined to 4 after be read l i (could be te/ti). l. 4: 'belol?ḫke?' - small S read l (or e); last sign before the divider hatched and marked 'sic' by Griffith (e?). l. 5: 'amni' - S + 2 = a, ℷ joined to the tail = m. l. 6: 'towi', to = ب with dot. l. 7: '3 /' read s o (could be q). The 'U' under the caption is the printer's signature mark, not part of the text.
